author.name: Semi Erendönmez
credits: Octatrack module and DSP56300 code by Semi Erendönmez, after his FRAMELOSS plugin's error modes
Effect ABI, schema, harness conventions and the tempo idiom: octabam (Sam Banks, MIT); the noise generator follows Analog BD's LCG idiom

presentation.label: CODEC + LINK FAILURES
presentation.summary: Codec and link failures on the project's tempo: ADPCM down to 2 bits, held samples, lost packets replayed, CD errors and frozen steps.
presentation.overview: DROPOUT sends the track through a failing codec and link. BITS codes it with ADPCM at 5, 4, 3 or 2 bits a sample. Errors arrive at random, RATE of them a step: HOLD holds the last good sample, PCKT replays the packet before a lost one, fading, and CIRC conceals a few bad samples as a CD player does or mutes a long burst; SIZE sets how long. FRZ freezes whole steps: a frozen step plays its first FRM samples and loops them to its end. STEP (1/32 to 1/4) follows the project's tempo. At the defaults, or with MIX at 0, the output is the input, bit for bit.
highlights: ADPCM codec at 5, 4, 3 or 2 bits a sample (BITS)
Link errors on the tempo: held samples, lost packets replayed, CD concealment and muted bursts
Steps frozen on their first frame, 1/32 to 1/4 at the project's tempo
Untouched at the defaults or MIX 0, bit for bit
usage: On an audio track, hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2), turn LEVEL to DROPOUT and press YES.
On the main page RATE sets how many errors a step and SIZE how long; BITS brings in the codec, FRZ freezes steps on their first FRM samples, MIX blends it all over the dry.
FX1 SETUP holds MODE (HOLD, PCKT, CIRC) and STEP (1/32 to 1/4). Turn RATE, BITS and FRZ to 0, or MIX to 0, for the untouched track.

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: Error events a step: none at 0, one in 16 steps at 1, 16 a step at 127

controls.name: SIZE
controls.doc: An error's length: HOLD 4-512, PCKT 64/128/256, CIRC 1-8 hidden, 16-1024 muted

controls.name: BITS
controls.doc: The ADPCM codec: off, then 5, 4, 3 and 2 bits a sample

controls.name: FRZ
controls.doc: The chance a step freezes on its first frame; 127 = every step

controls.name: FRM
controls.doc: The frozen frame: 64 to 1016 samples (1.5 to 23 ms)

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: The failures over the dry; 0 = the dry, bit for bit

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: The error: a held sample, a lost packet replayed, CD concealment

controls.name: STEP
controls.doc: The step RATE and FRZ count in, at the project's tempo

limitations: Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta) with an effect id of its own; the card builds' non-stock ids are all claimed but 0x07, which the draft holds as a placeholder.
Follows the project's tempo (stock's tempo24 word), not the sequencer's step phase, transport, swing or track speed: its step clock runs free from the moment the effect is chosen.
On FX1 the tempo word is read six words further into the record than on FX2, a place derived from octabam's measurements, not yet measured; a word outside 30-300 BPM counts the steps at 120 BPM.
Uses 3,072 words of the slot's buffer, which an FX1 slot holds; the first 128 frames after it is chosen pass the dry while it clears.
The codec's aliasing, the hard edges of errors and the frozen frame's seam are deliberate glitches; GSM, MP3 and ATRAC are not included.
Not yet run in a built image, the ColdFire port or on a unit: only in fxhost (the vendored DSP56300 emulator alone).

storage.label: DSP program / table / buffer
storage.conditions: dsp_asm: 617 program words and one 323-word P table per core. 59 state words in each instance's own r7 block. 3,072 words of the allocator's Y buffer per instance (a 512-frame ring and the frozen frame).

processing.label: DSP instruction peak
processing.conditions: fxhost (dsp56kEmu alone), one instance, 16-frame calls at the dearest settings (both 2-bit coders, PCKT 256 at RATE 127, every 1/32 step frozen, MIX gliding, with and without a trig split): 4,354 instructions a call. Executed instructions, not chip cycles; not yet measured beside stock SPRING REV in dsp_host.

impact.conditions: One instance at its dearest settings.

cpu.rationale: No ColdFire code: a cloned effect descriptor; the stock pages publish the knobs.

dsp.rationale: 274 executed instructions a sample in fxhost, below the 314 octabam's benchmark reports for stock SPRING REV; not measured under the same benchmark.

memory.rationale: 940 program-memory words on each DSP core (617 code, 323 table); 59 state words and 3,072 buffer words per instance.

tests.summary: fxhost only (the vendored dsp56kEmu with the module alone, no firmware): at the defaults and at MIX 0 the output is the input bit for bit from garbage state and buffer and with trig splits; HOLD, PCKT and CIRC match their arithmetic; the ADPCM's SNR falls with the bits (51/45/37/25 dB); the step's length follows the tempo word at 120, 96.5 and 174 BPM and falls back to 120 BPM outside 30-300 BPM, on FX1's and FX2's record; RATE's errors follow the tempo; a garbage buffer is never heard; idle reaches digital silence in every mode; nothing outside the audio, state, parameter and buffer words is written; 274 instructions a sample at the dearest settings. Not run in a built image, under the ColdFire port or on a unit.

license.declaration: Original DSP56300 code and tables by Semi Erendönmez, GPL-3.0-or-later. No Elektron firmware, extracted routines, tables, samples or dumps are included; no stock table is read.

access.location: Audio track FX1 or FX2 SETUP: DROPOUT in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2) to open its SETUP page.
Turn LEVEL to DROPOUT and press YES; MODE and STEP appear on the SETUP page.
Press FX1 (or FX2) for the main page: RATE, SIZE, BITS, FRZ, FRM and MIX.
